verdict.rationale: Foreloop documents a CLI that covers projects, loops, intentions, stories and tasks, with stable `--json` output, meaningful exit codes and token auth for CI. It also says the CLI and MCP let agents read and update Foreloop, so much of the core object model is programmatically reachable. However, nothing claims full UI parity, there is no documented general-purpose API, and some actions are only described as UI or GitHub actions (e.g. 'Link PR in the intention', the admin failure-threshold opt-in). Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity guarantee, documented REST/HTTP API reference, evidence that admin settings, feedback triage and PR linking are API-accessible, independent corroboration.
